metadata.publisher: India Meteorological Department, State Agro-Meteorological Centre Visakhapatnam / AMFU Guntur
metadata.title: Agromet Advisory Service Bulletin for the State of Andhra Pradesh
metadata.geographic_scope: Andhra Pradesh bulletin. The reviewed AMFU Guntur subsections cover Krishna with NTR and West Godavari with Eluru. Pilot passages index Krishna and West Godavari only.
metadata.review_notes: Downloaded official PDF and checked issue and validity on the cover. Compared the English rice rows in the rendered district tables on PDF pages 21 and 24. The publisher updates this URL in place.

passages.section: AMFU Guntur · Krishna & NTR districts · Rice row, soil moisture bullet
passages.content: Keep enough moisture in the soil as the rice grain fills and hardens. Avoid overwatering and standing water.
passages.review_notes: Checked the district header, rice row and stage column visually. Paraphrase. The source provides no irrigation depth or schedule.

passages.section: AMFU Guntur · Krishna & NTR districts · Rice row, harvest and drying bullet
passages.crop_stage: Physiological maturity (action condition in the milk-to-grain-hardening row)
passages.content: Harvest at physiological maturity, when roughly 80–85% of grains in a panicle are mature. Dry grain to 12–14% moisture before storage.
passages.review_notes: Checked both percentages and the maturity qualifier against the page image. Paraphrase. This bullet does not set a weather-safe harvest time.

metadata.title: 5 Days Value Added Forecast for Andhra Pradesh
metadata.geographic_scope: District rows across Andhra Pradesh. Only the Krishna and West Godavari rows are indexed for this pilot.
metadata.review_notes: Downloaded official PDF. Checked issue date, forecast dates, English and Telugu district labels, and rainfall columns against the rendered parallel tables. The URL updates in place.

passages.content: Issued 23 November. District rainfall forecast for 24, 25, 26, 27 and 28 November respectively (mm): 1.0, 1.8, 1.3, 1.0, 0.4.
passages.review_notes: Compared the five dates and rainfall cells visually with the English table and cross-checked the parallel Telugu district block. Forecast values, not observed rain.

passages.content: Issued 23 November. District rainfall forecast for 24, 25, 26, 27 and 28 November respectively (mm): 1.9, 3.8, 1.8, 1.5, 0.7.

metadata.publisher: Acharya N. G. Ranga Agricultural University
metadata.title: Vyavasayam
metadata.geographic_scope: Andhra Pradesh university extension publication. The reviewed passage gives general paddy harvest guidance from a Maruteru research-station author and names no district of applicability.
metadata.review_notes: Compared PDF page 8 visually because the machine text uses a legacy Telugu font encoding. The masthead reports month and year only. The approved passage is background with no assigned district or forecast window.

passages.section: వరి కోత సమయంలో తీసుకోవలసిన మెళకువలు · second bullet
passages.content: కోత తర్వాత నిల్వకు ముందు వరి ధాన్యాన్ని 14 శాతం తేమ వచ్చే వరకు ఆరబెట్టాలని వ్యాసం సూచిస్తుంది.
passages.review_notes: Telugu paraphrase from the rendered page, not legacy extracted text. The visible second bullet gives 14% moisture. Geographic scope and validity are not extended from the author's affiliation or publication month.
